missionSettings.description: FAULT LINE 1/5 - BROKEN SKY. Day one. The federal government has fallen and the army has split along the language border. The South has switched on its radars and SAMs around Beauvechain and Chievres; while they stand, nothing northern can fly south of Brussels. Fly as the North from Brussels, Antwerp or Kortrijk and take the network apart: the early-warning radars, the SAM batteries and the fuel at Beauvechain. 45 minutes. Solo or co-op; the South is flown by the AI. Requires NOCustomMaps and the Belgica map (Nuclear Option Mod Manager). Fictional scenario: North = Boscali, South = Primeva. No nuclear weapons.

objectives.DisplayName: Destroy the southern radar and air defence network

outcomes.Message: The southern air defence network is down. The North owns the sky over Brabant - for now.
Out of time. The targets have dispersed.
North, this is Brussels Control. Southern radars at Beauvechain, Chievres and Wavre are painting everything north of the language border.
SAM batteries at Wavre and Nivelles cover the approach. Go low, kill the radars first, then the launchers.
Southern fighters are airborne from Beauvechain, Charleroi and Florennes. Expect company.
Destroy most of the network and the sky over Brabant is ours.
Five minutes left on the strike window.
